x: **Communication issues:** rude, curt or dismissive replies; typing in all caps; overusing emojis, slang or unprofessional abbreviations; long delays without updating the customer.

**Service quality failures:** inaccurate or incomplete information; copy-pasted replies without personalisation; closing the chat abruptly without the customer's consent; ignoring follow-up questions or not confirming resolution.

**Professionalism lapses:** not greeting or closing properly; impatience, sarcasm or a negative attitude; multitasking with slow, inattentive replies; leaving the customer waiting without explanation.
**Missed chats without valid proof:** more than 3 in a month without valid documentation.

body.x: Acceptable proof: screenshot or video of a device issue, internet disruption or LC issue; member left the chat in under 1 minute; a family emergency.
Not acceptable: device, internet or LC disruption without proof; LC notification missing without a video; forgetting to switch off chat before a break; not at the workstation.

x: Speaking negatively about a colleague, superior or department without them present.
Spreading unverified information, rumours or assumptions.
Focusing on personal matters instead of work.
Not contributing to solutions, improvement or clarity.
Happening in private conversations, side chats or group chats without constructive intent.
Inform your immediate superior or HOD of any medical leave at least 1 hour before shift start on the same day.
Submit the original medical certificate to the TL, Supervisor or HOD.
Medical leave without a certificate from a registered medical practitioner or government hospital counts as 2 days of annual leave (or 2 days of unpaid leave if no AL is left).
Paid sick leave is not granted for self-inflicted injury, misconduct, attempted suicide, carelessness, immorality, unlawful acts, provoked assault or use of non-prescribed drugs.
